lead_raw_text:
The trigonal compound Co2Te6 (reduced formula CoTe3) crystallizes in space group R-3m (No. 166), with a unit cell containing 24 atoms (Co6Te18) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies octahedral environments for both Co and Te centers, each with six geometric neighbors of the opposite element; the Co–Te distance ranges from 2.4828 to 2.5651 Å. The connectivity forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between Co- and Te-centered octahedra.
